errors.evidence: The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is "测试集" (Test set).

The values for Test2 are inaccurate. In particular, the values for d-vector (29%) and s-vector (28%) are incorrect and their relative relationship is inverted. The figure shows the d-vector (yellow) bar at approximately 28.2% and the s-vector (dark green) bar slightly higher at approximately 28.5%.

Multiple values for Test3 are incorrect. The value for '无特征提取' (green) is stated as 36% but is clearly below 35% in the chart (approx. 34.8%). Additionally, the values for d-vector (28%) and s-vector (27%) invert their actual relationship; the figure shows d-vector (approx. 26.8%) is lower than s-vector (approx. 27.5%).
The value for the '无特征提取' (green) bar in Test5 is stated as 33%, which is significantly incorrect. The bar in the figure is just above the 30% line, at approximately 31.2%.

The description identifies the color for '无特征提取' as '绿色' (green), but this color is also used to describe 's-vector' ('深绿色' - dark green). This is ambiguous. A more precise description would be 'light green' or 'lime green' to distinguish it from the 'dark green' of the s-vector.
